title_en: Discrete Diffusion Modeling by Estimating the Ratios of the Data Distribution
title_zh: 通过估计数据分布比率进行离散扩散建模

verified_metadata.title: Discrete Diffusion Modeling by Estimating the Ratios of the Data Distribution
verified_metadata.journal: Proceedings of the 41st International Conference on Machine Learning
verified_metadata.abstract: Score entropy learns discrete probability ratios for reverse continuous-time Markov chains, producing competitive non-autoregressive language models.
verified_metadata.comment: ICML 2024 Best Paper; PMLR metadata cross-checked with arXiv v3

sections.title: 作者信息
paragraphs: 作者 Aaron Lou、Chenlin Meng、Stefano Ermon；ICML 2024, PMLR 235, 32819–32848；对应 arXiv:2310.16834v3。核验全文30页；PMLR未列传统DOI。

sections.title: 研究问题
paragraphs: continuous diffusion依赖score ∇log p，但text/token state space没有普通梯度。如何定义可训练的discrete score，让reverse continuous-time Markov chain无需显式归一化整个vocabulary，并在likelihood、sampling与infilling上接近autoregressive language models？

sections.title: 背景
paragraphs: 离散reverse rates取决于相邻states的marginal probability ratio p_t(y)/p_t(x)。直接ratio matching或dimension-wise prediction可能不稳定/不一致。作者定义score entropy，使最优sθ(x)_y恰为这些ratios。
SEDD仍使用Transformer backbone和forward noise process；它是非autoregressive生成机制，不意味着一次network pass生成完整高质量序列。

sections.title: 模型与方法
paragraphs: 论文从finite-state CTMC推导implicit与denoising score entropy。denoising form只需从clean x0采样noisy xt和transition kernel，避免未知p_t；network输出与allowed transitions对应的ratios。
实现uniform与absorbing noise graphs，推导reverse sampler与Tweedie-style改进，并将conditioning/infilling作为clamping or reverse dynamics约束。训练在text8、OpenWebText和LM1B等语料上。

sections.title: 核心结果与证据
paragraphs: Table 1显示同规模SEDD在多个zero-shot datasets上优于D3PM等离散diffusion，并与GPT-2量级autoregressive baselines竞争；Table 2在text8报告bits-per-character。
Figure 1按生成样本文本的external perplexity比较SEDD与GPT-2，SEDD无需temperature/nucleus annealing也能保持较好质量；sampling steps可与quality交换。Tables 4–5展示prefix/suffix infilling。
‘32× fewer evaluations’是相对论文自身特定diffusion sampler/quality点，不等于比所有autoregressive systems快32×；wall-clock还受每步全序列attention成本影响。

sections.title: 有效性与局限
paragraphs: 评估模型规模和数据远小于当前frontier LLM；perplexity由模型likelihood或外部evaluator测量，不能完整代表语义事实性。diffusion采样仍多步，长序列memory/latency未充分解决。
score ratios依赖noise graph；uniform graph在大vocabulary需结构化输出，absorbing schedule引入mask inductive bias。结果不保证任意discrete domains或conditional generation都同样有效。

sections.title: 复现与资源
paragraphs: 复现需固定dataset/tokenizer、noise graph/schedule、small/medium Transformer configs、training tokens、likelihood estimator、sampling steps与temperature-free decoding，并记录hardware latency。Evidence status: full-text verified theoretical/empirical study; no independent reproduction performed.
